lines.1: 「Indeed. You all seem to have energy to spare.」
lines.2: 「So don't stop at a pillow fight. If you're going to play, make it spectacular. I will give one of these to each of you.」
lines.3: The director handed everyone a bag.
lines.5: 「And this is a wristband. Put it on.」
lines.7: 「Behold Ryuumeikan's famous Flying Combat Deathmatch! It normally uses bows and arrows, but I have made a few adjustments.」
lines.8: 「Shoot it out among yourselves. This way, the boys and girls are evenly matched. Take one another out until only one of you remains.」
lines.9: 「When one of these guns hits you, your wristband will react and count you out--or dead, as it were.」
lines.10: 「The ammunition is something like red plasma rounds. A hit carries an impact, but it does not hurt and is completely harmless.」
lines.11: 「The wristband will sound if you leave the school grounds, and it will also sound if you try to force it off.」
lines.12: 「The time limit is two hours. The last survivor wins.」
lines.13: 「The reward will be one Dragon Ticket.」
lines.19: Present that ticket to the director, and he would grant any one exception.
lines.20: For example, if you wanted to skip class or had been absent, submitting a Dragon Ticket would get you marked present.
lines.21: Even if you failed a test, one ticket per subject would raise your score to a bare pass.
lines.22: Honor students dreamed of using one for a day off, while poor students coveted one as protection against a failing grade. It was the kind of ticket students drooled over.
lines.23: That made them extraordinarily rare, and they almost never became available.
lines.24: 「If more than one person remains when the two hours are up, everyone loses.」
lines.26: 「What a shocking premise. Nobody's ever come up with anything like it before.」
lines.27: 「And the winner gets a Dragon Ticket!」
lines.29: 「Well? Sounds like fun, does it not?」
lines.30: 「Director, I would say this goes beyond mere play...」
lines.31: 「Kurogane... This will not be a contest of brute strength alone. Information, cunning, and strategy will decide the battle. I believe it will be a valuable experience.」
lines.32: 「I see. It is part of their education. In that case...」
lines.35: 「It's an item that can save you from a failing grade, after all.」
lines.37: 「I was getting bored anyway. Let's do this.」
lines.39: 「If I am competing, I will not lose.」
lines.40: 「Something that useful cannot hurt to have.」
lines.42: 「You should play too, Yoppi. Someone like you might be the one who unexpectedly survives to the end, you know?」
lines.46: 「Coconut, you'll be the first one I hunt down and kill. Say your prayers. I'll shoot you even if you wave a white flag.」
lines.49: 「Now then, spread out wherever you like at five-minute intervals. The game begins when the bell rings.」
lines.50: 「We will stay here and see how it plays out.」
lines.52: The school was utterly silent at night.
lines.53: Not sensing anyone around made it eerie.
